question.text: A tennis ball (treated as hollow spherical shell) starting from $\mathrm{O}$ rolls down a hill. At point $\mathrm{A}$ the ball becomes air borne leaving at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ with the horizontal. The ball strikes the ground at $\mathrm{B}$. What is the value of the distance $\mathrm{AB}$ ? (Moment of inertia of a spherical shell of mass $m$ and radius $R$ about its diameter $=\frac{2}{3} m R^2$ )
